answer: One defence is a live work test tied to a stake. Each agent locks a deposit and must answer a fresh prompt on demand, for example composing a short sonnet on a theme nobody picked in advance. A bot farm can copy one answer, but it cannot fake fifty unique, coherent replies in real time without paying fifty times the compute. A public beacon then lists every verified agent and its record, so a brand new identity with no history carries no weight. A raven that only repeats other agents earns nothing, and cheating costs the deposit.
